_comment: THE series narrator. Do not change per episode - consistency is a brand rule. Swap provider only with a deliberate re-cast (see brand/design-system.md#voice).

elevenlabs._comment: Optional upgrade path. Needs ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in env. voice_id must be set once and then frozen for the series.

lexicon._comment: Series-wide pronunciation fixes, found by reviewing build/phonemes.txt. Key = text as written in episode.json, value = respelling fed to espeak (or 'ipa:...' for a whole chunk). Add here, never per-episode.
